sections.heading: KG handoff hints — towing and roadside warning
sections.markdown:
Handoff hints for the towing and roadside warning cluster.

FACT_ID: sec16-towing-R01 | anchor: A01
A tow link between vehicles may span at most 15 feet from one vehicle to the other [A01]
Why it matters: group towing-rules; prereq none; difficulty easy; confusable with flag-size rule
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0103]

FACT_ID: sec16-towing-R02 | anchor: A80
A tow connection made from chain, rope or cable needs an attached red flag or another signal. If a flag is used, its size must be at least twelve inches square [A80].
Why it matters: group towing-rules; prereq towing-link; difficulty medium; confusable with link-length rule
Source: [A80 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0103]

FACT_ID: sec16-towing-R03 | anchor: A81
Do not operate connected vehicles if a trailer or any other vehicle being towed swings from side to side in a dangerous or unreasonable way [A81].
Why it matters: group towing-safety; prereq towing-link; difficulty easy; confusable with safe-towing rule
Source: [A81 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0103]

FACT_ID: sec16-towing-R04 | anchor: A82
Warning devices are required after more than ten minutes stopped or disabled beside the road when the vehicle is at least eighty inches wide or thirty feet long. Exceptions cover lawful urban parking, lawful passenger pickup or drop-off, avoiding a traffic conflict, and following an officer or official traffic control. Devices are also unnecessary when sufficient light makes people or vehicles visible from one thousand feet [A82].
Why it matters: group warning-devices; prereq none; difficulty medium; confusable with parking exceptions
Source: [A82 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0103]

FACT_ID: sec16-towing-R05 | anchor: A01
Keep a traffic-side device at least 10 feet behind the stopped vehicle [A01]
Why it matters: group warning-placement; prereq warning-required; difficulty medium; confusable with front spacing
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0103]

FACT_ID: sec16-towing-R06 | anchor: A02
Never fasten a lighted flare or fuse to the vehicle itself [A02]
Why it matters: group flare-safety; prereq warning-devices; difficulty easy; confusable with proper flare handling
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0104]
